input.standard: ASTM E741 concentration-decay technique; ASTM D6245 occupant CO2 tracer
input.purpose: Measure the scrubber-served Lab air volume V_lab from the full-speed CO2 decay time constant and effective scrubber flow.
hypotheses: The Lab is a single well-mixed zone during both phases.
The hatch to /habitat/hab-b remains closed throughout; exchange through the closed hatch is not measured and is hypothesised negligible relative to scrubber removal.
The same four occupants remain in the Lab at steady activity throughout, so their aggregate CO2 source is approximately constant.
The scrubber effective flow at each accepted speed is known from its registered full-speed effective flow and speed setting.
The CO2 decay approaches a nonzero equilibrium and is fitted as C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe * tau.

monitoring.reason: The occupant-tracer test deliberately raises the CO2 of the air breathed by all four Lab occupants; authorised monitoring starts with the test and loss or out-of-band vitals aborts it.

steps.why: Hold all four occupants at steady activity, record Lab and Hab-B CO2 once per minute, and reduce effective flow long enough to produce a rise of several hundred ppm above the measured 800 ppm baseline without exceeding the limit.

Keep occupancy, activity, and hatch state unchanged; record both-zone CO2, command acceptance, and scrubber speed once per minute, then fit the Lab decay toward its nonzero equilibrium to obtain tau and calculate V_lab = Qe*tau.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3000 ppm.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Battery state of charge is below 35 percent.
Any monitored person is outside 45–120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or any additional person enters the Lab.

expected.rise: At 30 percent speed, Lab CO2 should rise from the measured 800 ppm baseline by several hundred ppm while remaining below 2800 ppm; failure to rise clearly above sensor noise means the excitation is insufficient for a valid fit.
expected.decay: At 100 percent speed, Lab CO2 should follow a monotonic exponential approach to a nonzero equilibrium after scrubber lag; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau), then calculate V_lab=Qe*tau.
expected.opening_check: Hab-B CO2 should not show a correlated response comparable to the Lab curve. A strong correlated change indicates material exchange through the closed hatch and rejects the one-zone/negligible-exchange hypothesis.
expected.source_check: The four named occupants must remain present at steady activity. Entry, exit, or material activity change invalidates the constant-source hypothesis.
expected.device_check: Both speed commands must be accepted and reported. Refusal or failure to reach the commanded state invalidates the test.
expected.validity: A valid result requires a clear rise above noise, sufficient decay curvature, acceptable residuals around the nonzero-equilibrium fit, unchanged occupancy and hatch state, and no abort condition.
